title: Gorenstein ascent and descent for flat local ring homomorphisms
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof compares residue-field Ext over the base and total rings through flat base change and a restriction right adjoint. In the descent direction it extracts the exact single-degree fibre dualizing complex after proving the base Gorenstein by faithful flatness. This controls injective dimension and the closed fibre simultaneously.
